test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

Hurry up ! There’s still ________ work left to do.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is emphasizing the quantity of work left to do, which is uncountable.
 
• The word 'much' is used with** uncountable nouns to indicate a large quantity.**
 
• Use 'much' with uncountable nouns to indicate a large quantity.
 
 
• ​Example: There isn't **much **water left in the bottle.
 
 

Hence, the correct statement is '**Hurry up ! There’s still much work left to do.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 = Incorrect = '**many**' is used with countable nouns and is not suitable here.
 
• Option 3 = Incorrect =** 'whole**' does not fit contextually as it refers to something complete or entire.
 
• Option 4 = Incorrect =** 'lot'** is informal and would require a preceding article, such as 'a lot of'
